verdict.rationale: Logseq's block reference syntax `(())` embeds/transludes an individual block from any page into another, and page reference `[[]]` links pages, with both staying live-synced to the source since they are references, not copies. Docs explicitly describe block referencing and page referencing as core native features. missing for 10: no independent hands-on demonstration of transclusion sync behavior, and no explicit mention of section-level (multi-block) transclusion beyond single blocks/queries.
